subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body:
4/5 — the rep was polite. One thing that would help me: when I called in, the phone agent walked me through a mock version of the reply email so I would know what to expect. It read like this:

"Hi — about your two $89 entries: the second is a deferred onboarding step tied to a review on your account (the WC-12 onboarding record). The review reason on file is [the case's business reason], and the hold releases when it closes."

I would like the actual reply email to follow the same shape so it matches what I was told on the phone. Everything else was handled well.
